# God agent

Adds a `god` agent. When `god` handles a request, its system prompt is replaced with the prompt configured for the current model ID. Every other agent keeps its normal system prompt.

The plugin ships no prompt content. You provide the files or URLs.

## Install

Standalone:

```jsonc
// opencode.jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@max10240/opencode-plugin-god",
      "options": {
        "models": {
          "*": "~/.config/opencode/god/default.md",
          "deepseek-v4.1-flash": "~/.config/opencode/god/deepseek-v4.1-flash.md"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Through Unicorn:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@max10240/opencode-plugin-unicorn",
      "options": {
        "features": { "god": true },
        "god": {
          "models": {
            "deepseek-v4.1-flash": "~/.config/opencode/god/deepseek-v4.1-flash.md"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Enable it with `features.god: true` or by providing a `god` options object. `features.god: false` disables it.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `models` | object | `{}` | Model ID to prompt source mapping |
| `cache` | boolean | `true` | Cache loaded prompts |
| `cacheTtlMs` | number | `60000` | HTTP cache lifetime |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `10000` | HTTP request timeout |

See [config.example.jsonc](https://github.com/Max10240/opencode-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/packages/opencode-plugin-god/config.example.jsonc) for a complete example.

## Model matching

- Keys are matched against the model ID only. The provider is ignored, so the same model served by two providers uses the same prompt.
- An exact model ID wins over the `"*"` fallback.
- Without an exact match or `"*"`, the request fails with an error.
- Provider-prefixed keys such as `"openai/model-id"` are ordinary model IDs and do not match `model-id`.

## Prompt sources

- `https://` or `http://` URL
- `file://` URL
- Absolute local path
- `~/` path
- Relative path, resolved against the workspace directory

Local files are revalidated on each request by modification time and size. HTTP responses are cached for `cacheTtlMs`. Set `cache` to `false` to load every request.

If a source cannot be loaded, is not a file, or contains only whitespace, the request fails with an error.

The `god` agent does not fall back to the default system prompt. Configure every model you use with it, or add a `"*"` entry.

## Notes

- Select the `god` agent explicitly; other agents are never modified.
- The plugin only reads text. Prompt content and provider terms are your responsibility.
- Use either the standalone plugin or Unicorn, not both at the same time.

## Development

```bash
bun test
bun run typecheck
bun run build
```

# God agent

新增一个名为 `god` 的 agent。只有使用 `god` 时，才会按当前 model ID 替换 system prompt；其他 agent 不受影响。

插件本身不包含任何提示词内容，文件或 URL 由你提供。

## 安装

单独使用：

```jsonc
// opencode.jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@max10240/opencode-plugin-god",
      "options": {
        "models": {
          "*": "~/.config/opencode/god/default.md",
          "deepseek-v4.1-flash": "~/.config/opencode/god/deepseek-v4.1-flash.md"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

通过 Unicorn 使用：

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@max10240/opencode-plugin-unicorn",
      "options": {
        "features": { "god": true },
        "god": {
          "models": {
            "deepseek-v4.1-flash": "~/.config/opencode/god/deepseek-v4.1-flash.md"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

使用 Unicorn 时，通过 `features.god: true` 或提供 `god` 配置对象来启用；`features.god: false` 会关闭。

## 选项

| 选项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `models` | object | `{}` | model ID 到提示词来源的映射 |
| `cache` | boolean | `true` | 是否缓存已加载的提示词 |
| `cacheTtlMs` | number | `60000` | HTTP 缓存时间 |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `10000` | HTTP 请求超时 |

完整示例见 [config.example.jsonc](https://github.com/Max10240/opencode-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/packages/opencode-plugin-god/config.example.jsonc)。

## 模型匹配

- 只按 model ID 匹配，provider 不参与，因此同一模型由不同 provider 提供时使用同一个提示词。
- 精确 model ID 优先于 `"*"` 回退项。
- 没有精确匹配也没有 `"*"` 时，请求直接报错。
- `"openai/model-id"` 这类 provider 前缀只是普通 model ID，不会匹配 `model-id`。

## 提示词来源

- `https://` 或 `http://` URL
- `file://` URL
- 绝对路径
- `~/` 路径
- 相对路径，以工作区目录为基准

本地文件每次请求都会按修改时间和大小重新校验。HTTP 响应在 `cacheTtlMs` 内缓存。将 `cache` 设为 `false` 可每次重新加载。

加载失败、不是文件、或内容只有空白时，请求直接报错。

`god` 不会回退到默认 system prompt。请为每个会使用的模型配置映射，或添加 `"*"` 回退项。

## 说明

- 需要显式选择 `god` agent；其他 agent 永远不会被修改。
- 插件只读取文本；提示词内容和 provider 条款由你负责。
- 单独插件和 Unicorn 二选一，不要同时启用。

## 开发

```bash
bun test
bun run typecheck
bun run build
```
